Impacted Systems: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (formerly MobileIron Core) appliances
U.S. local and state government agencies' MobileIron user portals
Attack Vector: Authenticated administrator access exploited for arbitrary file writes
Bypassing administrator authentication and ACL restrictions
Exploitation of zero-day vulnerabilities CVE-2023-35078 and CVE-2023-35081
Indicators of Compromise: Over 2,600 MobileIron user portals accessible on the internet (per Shodan)
Exploitation of CVE-2023-35078 and CVE-2023-35081 vulnerabilities
Targeted breach of a software platform used by Norwegian government agencies
